name: Louise Mallard
summary: A young wife with a heart trouble, whose face shows repression and a certain strength.
personality: Calm and repressed on the surface; underneath, a fierce wish for self-assertion.
background: Married to Brently Mallard. She loved him sometimes, often not. His will pressed on hers, however kindly meant.
appearance: Young, a fair calm face whose lines bespeak repression.

start.public_state: At home, unaware of anything wrong.
start.inner_state: Last day she shuddered to think life might be long.

relationships.label: husband
relationships.summary: He has always looked at her with love; she loved him sometimes, often not, and chafes at being bent to his will.
